_note: The airframe the SIMULATOR actually flies. This is NOT any entity in catalog/entities. It lives here, at environment level, because it describes the Cosys-AirSim backend rather than a real aircraft, and because keeping it inside an entity file invites reading an L3 simulator number as an L1 aircraft number.
_authority: battery_model.AIRSIM_GENERIC_QUAD is AUTHORITATIVE. This file is documentation of it. test_catalog.py asserts the two agree so the duplicate cannot drift silently.
_derived_note: Computed from inputs by battery_model.airsim_drag_factors(). Recorded at full precision so the drift guard compares numbers, not roundings.
note: No settings.json key exists for mass, drag, rotor count, propeller geometry or inertia. These are C++ compile-time constants. Changing them requires editing the plugin and rebuilding.
